name: Soyuz T-2
about: Soyuz T-2 (1980-045A), a crewed vehicle (7K-ST), launched 1980 Jun  5. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1980 Jun  6), held fixed
docked to S10382; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
